value.behaviour: On the not-found path only, resolves the URL's ref as a former ref and redirects to the current entity URL with a renamedFrom marker; when an entity loads with the marker, posts a dismissible renamed notice and drops the marker.
rules: 1. Keep the existing entity fetch (useAsyncRetry over catalogApi.getEntityByRef) and the missing-name effect exactly as they are.

2. New hooks: useLocation and useParams from react-router-dom (splat = useParams()['*'] ?? ''), alertApiRef via useApi, entityRoute = useRouteRef(entityRouteRef), t from useTranslationRef(catalogTranslationRef) imported from '@backstage/core-plugin-api/alpha' and '../../alpha/translation'.

3. Former lookup with useAsync from 'react-use/esm/useAsync', deps [catalogApi, kind, namespace, name, loading, error, entity]: return undefined unless name is set, loading is false, error is unset, entity is undefined and catalogApi.getEntityRefByFormerRef exists; otherwise return await catalogApi.getEntityRefByFormerRef({ kind, namespace, name }) inside try/catch, returning undefined on any error. A normal load therefore makes no extra request (FR-13).

4. A useEffect navigates when the lookup yields a ref: target path is entityRoute(entityRouteParams(newRef, { encodeParams: true })) plus `/${splat}` when splat is non-empty; search params are a copy of new URLSearchParams(location.search) with renamedFrom set to stringifyEntityRef({ kind, namespace, name }); then the hash. Call navigate(`${path}?${params}${location.hash}`, { replace: true }).

5. A second useEffect runs when an entity is loaded and new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('renamedFrom') is set: unless a useRef already holds that value, store it, call alertApi.post({ message: t('entityPage.renamedNotice', { formerRef }), severity: 'info' }), then remove renamedFrom from a copy of the params and navigate(`${location.pathname}${rest ? `?${rest}` : ''}${location.hash}`, { replace: true }).

6. Returned loading is loading || formerLookup.loading || Boolean(formerLookup.value), so the not-found UI never flashes before a redirect; entity, error and refresh are returned as today. When the lookup yields nothing or throws, the existing not-found UI shows unchanged.

7. Imports from '@backstage/plugin-catalog-react' add entityRouteParams; from '@backstage/catalog-model' import stringifyEntityRef; from '@backstage/core-plugin-api' add alertApiRef and useRouteRef; from 'react' add useRef.

sites.rule: Rewrite the imports and the hook body per rules 1-7, keeping `export const useEntityFromUrl = (): EntityLoadingStatus =>`.
